title: A cellar ledger in a looping, impatient hand
found_at: Castle Dimitrescu — the wine cellar, on a lectern beside the racks. Not hidden.
requires: Access to the cellar, which means either invitation or not being caught.
language: Romanian, with dates in a European hand
text:
Most of it is inventory — vintages, volumes, names of the sources ruled through when spent. The hand is even and bored for pages at a time.

What a careful reader notices is the arithmetic. Consumption runs steady, four to six units a week, for months. Then a week of eleven. Then fourteen. Then steady again.

The heavy weeks are dated. Someone has also noted, in the margin of each, a single word: *vizită*. Visit.

The last such week is recent. Beside it, pressed hard enough to tear the paper, the pen has gone through the page twice.
gm_notes: Yields the RUMOUR of her resentment: something about Miranda's visits costs her, badly. It does not yield why, or that she wants Miranda dead. A player who works this out has done real work and should be rewarded with the rumour, not the truth. If they later hear it from Alcina herself, the truth supersedes.
